History of Japan
 

 

In order to understand any contemporary society, a knowledge of its history is essential. The following pages present the most general facts of Japanese history.

Periods of Japanese History

Early Japan
 (until 710)

Nara and Heian Periods
 (710-1192)

Kamakura Period
 (1192-1333)

Muromachi Period
 (1338-1573)

Azuchi-Momoyama Period
 (1573-1603)

Edo Period
 (1603-1868)

Meiji Period
 (1868-1912)

Taisho and Early Showa Period
 (1912-1945)

Postwar Period
 (since 1945)
